text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Following the recent incident at the Landosol
Expo, {0} was invited by Nephy Nella
to the Demon's Foot Citadel as a gesture of
goodwill...
text_block_list.orig_text:
先日の『ランドソル万博』の一件を受け、
ネフィ＝ネラから改めてお礼がしたいと
鬼岩城砦へ招待された{0}だったが……

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
...Welcome, come in! I've got some good
monster meat in stock! If you're capable of
removing the deadly poison from within, it'll
be so juicy your cheeks will fall off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──らっしゃい、
らっしゃい！
いい魔物肉、
仕入れてるよー！
致死毒をうまく毒抜きすれば、
頬っぺたも落ちるほどのジューシーさだ！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 2
text_block_list.text:
Hear this, right now... Basilisk eyes are 30%
off! They still have some power in them, so
you'll be petrified if you're found staring
carelessly... but if you eat them carefully,
you're sure to enjoy a delicious,
melt-in-your-mouth flavor!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんと今なら、
バジリスクの目玉が３割引き！
まだ魔力が残ってるから
目を合わせると石化しちゃうけど、
気を付けて食べれば
口の中でとろけるうまみが広がること
間違いなし！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Such an outrageously bizarre spectacle is a
specialty unique to my Gio Gehenna. In other
worlds, it would be a rarity one could
scarcely hope to witness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
斯様な奇怪極まる興行は、
此のジオ・ゲヘナならではの趣向。
他の世界では、
とても御目に掛かれぬ珍事でありんしょう。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
It is called the "Great Monster Market". Held
only once every few years, it is an event
where rare monster meats, normally unseen,
are brought out and sold in abundance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
名を、
『大魔物市』
と申しんす。
幾年に一度しか開かれぬ催事故、
稀有なる魔物の肉なども
此処ぞとばかり
売り出されることもありますれば。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~ I was surprised to hear the Princess
had invited you to attend "The Great
Monsterfolk Market", Lord Knight-san~ But
well, if the Princess is with us, it should
be fine~
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい～。
媛さまが急に騎士殿さんを
危険な『大魔物市』に招待したいとか
言い出した時は、
驚きました～
まぁでも、
媛さまがいるなら
大丈夫ですけど～

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
After the recent incident, you showed me
kindness beyond measure, Lord Knight. Thus,
in accordance with the customs of Gio
Gehenna, I wished to repay that debt in some
small way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先の一件にて、
騎士殿には
並々ならぬ御厚情を賜り候。
ジオ・ゲヘナの流儀にて、
せめてもの報恩を果たしたく思う
次第にあり申す。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
I understand you possess considerable
knowledge when it comes to monster cuisine.
Yet among the creatures displayed here at the
"Great Monster Market", I daresay you may
still find delicacies worthy of making even
your palate roar with delight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物食に於いては
多くの知見をお持ちと
拝察致しまするが、
此の『大魔物市』に並ぶ魔物ならば、
お前さまの舌を唸らせる逸品も
見つかることでありんしょう。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Should anything catch your fancy, pray tell
me. I would prepare it with my own hands and
serve it to you, Lord Knight. It is but a
small token of my gratitude, yet I would be
honored if you would accept it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
御心に適いし品あらば、
なんなりと
お申し付けくだしゃんせ。
わっち手づから調理し、
騎士殿に振る舞いたく思い侍り。
僅かばかりの心積もり、
御笑納いただければ
幸甚に存じまする。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
But... please be careful, okay? There are
plenty of monsters here that are a little too
lively. I've nearly been swallowed whole a
few times myself~
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも～、
気を付けてくださいね？
活きが良すぎる魔物もたくさん並べられてますので～
私も何回か
丸呑みにされそうになったことがあったり～

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
I have told you time and again that such
things are nothing to boast of. ...That said,
Lord Knight, you have nothing to fear. Should
the worst occur, I shall place this very body
between you and harm.
text_block_list.orig_text:
胸を張れることではないと、
常々嗜めておろうに。
……然れど、
騎士殿に於かれましては、
案ずるには及びませぬ也。
万一の事あらば、
此の身を盾とし
御守り致しんす。

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Lady Nephy Nella! It's an honor that you
would take an interest in my products! How
about it? I've got some overnight dried hydra
in stock! You can even try a sample!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ネフィ＝ネラさま！
うちの商品に目をかけてくださるとは
光栄です！
どうです、
ヒュドラの一夜干し！　
試食もできますよ～

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Oh... a sample, you say? Mm... a splendid
marbling of fat.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほう、
試食とな？
此れは美事な脂の差し具合也。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... My Lord Knight, what say you? If you
would not mind, please come closer to my
side.
text_block_list.orig_text:
フフ……
騎士殿や。
如何でありんしょう？
お前さまの差し障りあらねば、
どうぞわっちの御傍に。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Here... "Aaahn"♪

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
My Princess, so you're going to boldly feed
Lord Knight-san with your own hands...?!
Wait, no, no! That monster is known to be
highly toxic! It may be poison-free now, but
I'm sure he'll hesitate...
text_block_list.orig_text:
媛さまが自らの手で
騎士殿さんに
「あ～ん」を……！？
って、
いやいや！　
その魔物、
強力な毒性持ちですよ～！
毒抜きしてるとはいえ、
騎士殿さんもさすがにためらいますって～！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehhh?! H-He didn't hesitate at all...!
Isn't this being a tad TOO bold?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ～！？
そ、
そんな一切のためらいなく……！
大胆すぎませんか～！？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Praise be, praise be. A resolute boldness,
Lord Knight. True to your title as hero.
text_block_list.orig_text:
善哉、
善哉。
流石は騎士殿、
斯様に豪胆なる様は
正しく英雄の振る舞い也。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Mia. You should learn from Lord
Knight's bravery. Hold your head up high and
stretch your tail a little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これミーアや。
汝も騎士殿の勇ましさを学び遣り
少しは胸を張り、
尾を伸ばすがよかろうて。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Saying that to me, a civil servant...
Or rather, Lord Knight-san... I'm fairly sure
that's not boldness, but more a sense of
greed, am I right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ～……
文官の私に
そう言われましても～……
というか騎士殿さん……
豪胆とかじゃなくて
食い意地張ってるだけ、
とかじゃないですよね～？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Such rude remarks are unbecoming of you,
fool. Where is your pride as a citizen of
Purgatory...
text_block_list.orig_text:
無礼であるぞよ、
戯け者。
煉獄の民としての矜持を持ちなんし──

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 2
text_block_list.text:
UWAAAAAAAAAH?! This thing... IT SUDDENLY WENT
WILD!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわあああああっ！？
こいつ、
急に暴れ出したぞ！！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 3
text_block_list.text:
That's why I told you we shouldn't capture
those things alive! Even though their rarity
value goes down when they lose their
freshness...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから生け捕りはやめようっていったんだ！
鮮度が落ちると希少価値が下がるっつっても……！

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Merchants
text_block_list.text: EEEEEEEEKKKK!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ひぃぃぃっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Speak of the devil... Nay, the monster in
question--
text_block_list.orig_text:
あにはからんや
噂をすれば
影とやら──
喃。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Lord Knight, please step back for a moment. I
will put that monster's boiling blood to
rest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿や、
少しばかり御下がりくだしゃんせ。
彼の魔物、
頭に血が昇る事
甚だしき様子也。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
A sound reasoning. And as fortune would have
it, that monster happens to be exceedingly
delicious as well. I would very much like to
serve it to you later, Lord Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
合点でありんす。
折しも善きことに、
彼の魔物、
美味なる事も又甚だしければ。
是非是非
騎士殿に馳走したく思い侍り。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...If the bleeding is botched and the meat
crushed, the flavor will surely suffer... Yet
it cannot be helped. I cannot allow the
merchants' lives to be lost needlessly...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……血抜きをしくじり、
肉を潰せば、
味が落ちるは必定……
なれど、
止むを得ませぬ。
商人らの命、
あたら散らす訳にも──

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text: Please wait! Lady Nephy Nella!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待ちください！
ネフィ＝ネラさま！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ふむ？

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
You went out of your way to treat our
otherwordly guest to a home-cooked meal...
yet if you were to crush its ingredients,
it'd be all for nothing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかくネフィ＝ネラさまが、
お客人に手料理を振る舞おうというのに……
食材を潰してしまっては、
元も子もありません！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
Even without your help, we'll manage on our
own! It may seem presumptuous, but... leave
this to us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネフィ＝ネラさまのお力に頼らずとも、
我々だけでなんとかしてみます！
差し出がましいようですが……
ここはお任せを！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 2
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's right! We can't let you protect us
forever, Lady Nephy Nella!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうだ！
いつまでもネフィ＝ネラさまに守ってもらってばかりじゃ
いられねぇ！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 3
text_block_list.text:
We are the brave people of Gio Gehenna! Fight
with all your might so that Lady Nephy Nella
can safely welcome our guest!
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺たちはジオ・ゲヘナの勇猛な民だ！
ネフィ＝ネラさまが無事に客人をおもてなしできるよう、
全力を尽くして
戦え！

text_block_list.name: Merchants
text_block_list.text: Uooooooohhh!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: うおおおおおおっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...?! Somehow, I feel like I'm not going
to be able to watch this from a distance...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれぇ～……！？
なんだか、
安全に高みの見物とはいかなそうな空気～……！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
A-All right! I get it already! I know it
won't be of any use, but I'll at least try my
best! UWOOOOOOOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
分かりました！　
分かりましたよ～！
絶対役に立たないとは思いますけど、
私も一皮くらいは脱ぎます～！
うおおおぉぉ～～！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Well now... Things have taken quite an
unexpected turn. I wonder how this affair
will unfold.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……果て扨て。
思はぬ仕儀になって参りました喃。
如何なる仕儀と相成るやら。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for concern. Were I to
intervene here, it would be the height of bad
taste. For now, the best course is simply to
watch over them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
案ずるには及びますまい。
此処でわっちが手出しするとあっては、
無粋極まると申すもの。
見守るに如くはなし、
でありんしょう。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, in the wake of the recent
Landosol Expo, changes have begun to stir
even within Gio Gehenna. Those changes are
seen in the people... and in my own heart as
well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かてて加えて、
先の『ランドソル万博』の件を受け、
此のジオ・ゲヘナにも
変転が生じつつありまする。
其れは民草の移ろいにして……
我が心の移ろいにもありますれば。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Lord Knight. While we watch their struggle,
might I borrow your ear for a moment? Would
you indulge a little idle tale of mine?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿や。
彼奴らの奮闘を見守る間、
どうか御耳を拝借したく。
わっちの与太話に、
些とばかり
御付き合いくれませぬかの？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Time goes back. This story takes place during
the turmoil that occurred at the Landosol
Expo.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──時間は戻り。
『ランドソル万博』で起きた騒動の最中の話。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
In search of a legendary ingredient to create
her country's ultimate dish, Nephy Nella
traveled alone to a crater deep within Gio
Gehenna.
text_block_list.orig_text:
至高の料理を作るための伝説の食材を探しに、
ネフィ＝ネラは単独、
ジオ・ゲヘナの奥地にある
噴火口に赴いていた──

text_block_list.name: Eruption Yokozuna Boar God
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...Hoo. So this is the famed "Eruption
Yokozuna Boar God" I heard so much about.
With such a magnificent physique, the title
"God of Beasts" is no mere exaggeration.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ほぉう。
此れなるが伝承に聞く
『噴火横綱猪神』。
雄大極まる体躯、
獣の神なる二つ名も
大法螺に非ず。

text_block_list.name: Eruption Yokozuna Boar God
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Quite a troublesome foe indeed.
Strength beyond measure... and the swift legs
of an antelope. In my present weakened state,
it may prove a difficult opponent.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……成程、
此れ又厄介極まれり。
剛力に加え、
羚羊が如き健脚。
衰えたる今の我が身には、
些か難き相手やもしれぬ。

text_block_list.name: Eruption Yokozuna Boar God
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
A creature of monstrous strength and divine
terror, to face it head-on would be sheer
folly. Ordinarily one would resort to
stratagems... yet I cannot afford such
leisure now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
正に怪力乱神、
真っ向から相対するは愚直也。
策を弄するが定石なれど……
今は悠長にはして居れぬ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Then so be it, I shall crush that brute
strength with the full force of my being.
text_block_list.orig_text:
為らば其の剛力──
全霊にて
叩き伏せるまで。

text_block_list.name: Eruption Yokozuna Boar God
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...My, this is rather taxing for these old
bones. Mone, are you unharmed...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……やれ、
老骨には些と堪え申す喃。
これモネや、
身に異はなかろうて──

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...How forgetful of me. Mone and the others
fell for the "Prison Bee's" cunning plan, and
are now her prisoners. That is the reason I
came here alone... to save them all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……浮りと失念せり。
モネらは『獄蜂』の奸計に嵌り、
今や虜囚の身。
稚児らを救わんと、
供も連れず独り此処へ馳せ参じたというに。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Even this supposedly immortal body of mine
has grown so pitifully weak. Or perhaps,
surrounded by my people and passing the days
in quiet routine... I have come to accept the
simple truth that one cannot accomplish
everything alone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
不滅の我が身も、
浅ましがる程に
衰えたる哉。
将又民草に囲まれ、
徒然日々を重ねるうちに……
独りでは万事到らぬと云ふ、
然りぬべし道理と相成ったのやもしれぬ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Yet that is why I came here in such a rush.
To take back that truth into my own hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
故にこそ、
疾く参らん。
其の道理、
我が掌の裡に
取り戻さんが為に。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
How strange. To me, the common people are
beings that I should protect and seek to
safeguard. However, I never feel that way
around them on a daily basis.
text_block_list.orig_text:
奇なる哉。
此の身にとっての民草とは、
庇い護るべき存在なれど。
日頃より
傍らに覚ゆることはありませなんだ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
To me, they were no different from children.
By holding them in my hands and protecting
them from harm, I believe that the
preciousness of their life can be fully
honored.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっちにすれば、
あの者らの存在は
稚児も同様でありんした。
掌にて包み、
危難の及ばぬよう護り抜いてこそ、
命の尊きを全うできると──
然様に思うておりますれば。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
"An inhuman" like me playing a delicate game
in which I pretend to be a human...
Originally, it was nothing more than a
trivial matter.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『人でなし』が
人の真似事を演ずる、
細やかなる戯れ。
本来は、
只其れのみの些事に過ぎぬ仕儀に御座んした。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Please do not wear such a sorrowful face.
Since I met you and Mone grew up, my
perspective and thoughts have undergone a
transformation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
斯様な御顔をなさらないでくだしゃんせ。
騎士殿と出会い、
モネが育ち──
わっちの視座も思惟も、
今や変容を迎えておりまする。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
They face their fears and stand up to them.
Wielding a strong spirit that resides in
their heart. At some point, I was also
fascinated from the power a heart gives, and
so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
畏れと向き合い、
立ち向かう。
あの者らに宿りし、
強き心根。
その心の力に、
何時頃からか、
わっちは魅せられたが故に……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
It is no longer a trivial matter. Their mere
existence has changed me into something
better. Thus now, I shall simply watch over
their valiant struggle... and place my faith
in them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最早些事とは申しませぬ。
あの者らの存在は、
我が裡にて
大いなるものと変わりて候。
故に今は、
その雄姿を見守り、
信を成そうと思い侍り。

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Merchants
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAHHHHHHHH!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ぎゃああああああっ！？

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
W-We tried our best, but it's still
impossible! My Princessssss~!! P-Please save
meeeeee~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
が、
頑張ってはみましたけど、
やっぱり無理です～！
媛さま～！！
た、
助けてくださ～いっ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
That said... it seems it is still too early
for them to leave the palm of my hand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……と雖も。
此の掌より巣立つは、
未だ時期尚早のようでありますが喃。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: My unwavering "pride"... is right here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──不退転の矜持、
此処に在りて。

text_block_list.name: Giant Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
Th-That ferocious monster was dealt with in
one blow...? Marvelous as always, Lady Nephy
Nella!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの凶暴な魔物を一撃で……？
さすがはネフィ＝ネラさまだ！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 2
text_block_list.text:
She shot through the vital spot in the neck
without crushing any flesh! And she even
drained the blood without issue!
text_block_list.orig_text:
肉を潰すことなく、
首の急所だけを撃ち抜いた！
血抜きもバッチリだ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. Acceptable. No different than usual.
A demon's visage, a Buddha's heart... a
fitting adage for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふむ、
まずまず。
異しうは非ず也。
鬼面仏心──
我が身に馴染みて候。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that was a lifesaver…... As expected of
your unwavering strength, my Princess! Any
monster ends up right on the chopping board!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや～、
助かりました～……
さすがは媛さま、
そのお力はまさに
豪勇無双！
どんな魔物も、
まさにまな板の上ですね～！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Actually... If you could strike the vital
spot that precisely, Princess... wouldn't it
have been better if you'd taken that form
from the start instead of having us fight?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……と、
いいますか～
急所だけを的確に撃ち抜けるなら、
私たちが戦わなくても
最初から
媛さまが
そのお姿になればよかったのでは～……？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Had you known an easy solution awaited, you
would surely have grown lax, would you not?
Just as a lion sometimes drops its beloved
cub into the depths of a valley, it is also
my duty as a Princess to monitor my people's
growth.
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽を得らるると知らば、
汝は必ずや手を緩めたであろ？
時として
獅子が愛しき仔を谷底に落とすが如く、
その成長を見定むるも又、
媛たるわっちの役目にあろうて。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
And yet, that pitiful display... truly
lamentable. Your lack of training is obvious
at a glance. Very well then, everyone... I
shall drill you myself, just as I am.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにほどのことやありけむ、
彼の体たらくとは
嘆かわしき哉。
鍛錬足らずは一目瞭然。
となれば、
皆者──
此の身なりの儘に、
稽古をつけてくれようぞ。

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: EEEEEEEK!!?

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Nephy Nella looked a little annoyed at the
pitiful cries of her people. However, a sense
of satisfaction could also be found in her
expression...
text_block_list.orig_text:
情けない声を上げる民たちに、
少し呆れた様子のネフィ＝ネラ。
しかしその表情は、
どこか満たされているようでもあった……
